displayName.ja: 【ハロウィンナイト】 心願寺　紅

profile.ja: 吸血鬼と人間のハーフでありながら対魔忍として生きる異端の存在。“ふうま八将”のひとりでもあった祖父・心願寺幻庵から剣術の指南を受け、ゆくゆくは八将を継ぐと目されていた実力者。しかしかつての内紛でふうま宗家に助力した咎で幻庵は失脚。紅も里を離れ、現在はどこにも属さない独立した立場で行動している。元ふうま八将という出自から、宗家の跡取りであるふうま小太郎とも旧知の間柄。里を出奔したことで疎遠になっていたが、近頃闇の町で彼の噂を聞くことがあり、密かに気になっていた。
profile.en: Shinganji Kurenai is a half-vampire, half-human who walks the path of a Taimanin, an outlier even among her kind. She was taught swordsmanship by her grandfather, Shinganji Gen-an—one of the legendary Fuuma Eight Generals—and was once eyed as his successor. However, after Gen-an fell from grace for aiding the Fuuma clan during an internal conflict, Kurenai left her village and now operates independently, belonging to no faction. Because of her former status as a Fuuma Eight General, she has a longstanding acquaintance with Fuuma Kotaro, the clan's heir. Though they grew apart after she ran away, she's recently heard rumors of him in the dark town and finds herself quietly intrigued.

text.ja: は、はっぴーはろうぃん！　不慣れな催しだがこの心願寺紅、やるからには務めきってみせる
text.en: Ha—Happy Halloween! It's an unfamiliar event, but this Shinganji Kurenai will see it through to the end.

text.ja: ハロウィンか……海外の風習だが、対魔忍が参加するような事なのだろうか？
text.en: Halloween, huh… It's a foreign custom, but would a Taimanin even take part in something like that?

text.ja: ず、随分と可愛らしい衣装だが……まあ、これを着るくらい、どうと言う事もないな！
text.en: Th-the outfit's really cute… Well, I have no objection to wearing this!

text.ja: ハーフヴァンパイアだから仮装は不要？　面白いことを言う。イベントだからと浮かれすぎるなよ？
text.en: Because I'm a half-vampire, I don't need a costume? That's funny. Don't get too carried away just because it's an event.

text.ja: ハッピーハロウィン！　トリックオアトリート！　ううん、こんな感じで良いのか？
text.en: Happy Halloween! Trick or treat! Uh, is this how it's supposed to be?

text.ja: 仮装をした者達が町を練り歩く、やってみればこれはこれで……意外とたのしいな
text.en: Seeing the costumed folks parade through town—once you try it, it's actually… surprisingly fun.

text.ja: これか？　魔剣、パンプキンだ。意外と扱いやすくて気に入った
text.en: This? A demon sword, Pumpkin. It's surprisingly easy to handle, I like it.

text.ja: え？　い、いや、あやめにはこの事は言っていないんだ……絶対秘密だぞ！
text.en: Huh? N-no, I didn't tell Ayame about this… It's absolutely a secret!
